completionFields.summary: P-013 work-items list resolver cost, both halves. (1) Query cost: the page selects its keys first on hfc_updated_idx and hydrates payload + spine for the page only; the summary reads the stored severity_projection (migration 1308) instead of detoasting every payload. A/B on the same DB, 8 interleaved calls per port (server resolverMs): summary 1385 ms (:3070, old resolver blob e0b9c56f) -> 389 ms (:3170, new blob 0fc0d54c), -72%; page 272 -> 100 ms, -63%. Response bodies byte-identical between old and new (summary md5 c89464ff..., page id list md5 b329c549..., 87,698 matched). (2) Call rate (D-012): expensive aggregate targets get a 10 s bridged coalesce window. Concurrent SSE A/B 20:22-20:25Z: 47 -> 22 summary invalidations per 180 s (-53%); byHarness is delivered at the summary rate when subscribed (9/9 in 60 s on :3170), so page refetch tracks it. Matched calls/s x ms/call per open panel: 0.261/s x 1657 ms = 433 ms/s -> 0.122/s x 489 ms = 60 ms/s (-86%). Live write-to-summary staleness on :3170: p50 4.76 s, p90 9.90 s, max 10.59 s over 49 writes; the 10 s bound is at the bus and the <=0.59 s excess is [inferred] commit + NOTIFY + SSE transport.

completionFields.summary: P-014 DB CPU hotspots fixed and measured live. One 601 s A/B window (20:56:40-21:06:40Z, .papercusp/scratch/p014/win-2056/report.txt): new code was live on bg-host + staging while release :3070 still ran old code against the same DB, so per-call cost compares directly. (a) goals/spend-rollup goal_owners: 1,082 ms/call in window (cumulative new 526 ms/call, 140 calls), against 24,823 ms/call before (1,062 calls); about 23-47x. (b) presence-wakeability last-tool-call: new top-1-per-owner 0.70 ms/call (267 blocks/call), old GROUP BY max() 37.0 ms/call (17,984 blocks/call) in the same window; about 53x per call. The old shape still costs 154 ms DB time per wall second from :3070 until it deploys. (c) directive recipients: new index-usable shape (queryid 795733546427306199, text tagged '-- P-014(c)') 129 ms/call, 25,488 blocks; old 544 ms/call, 831,709 blocks; about 4.2x time and 33x fewer blocks (cumulative 119 vs 646 ms). (d) moved to P-015 with no change here. (e) su resource locks (migration 030 resource_acquire_shared/release_shared, mid-turn admission atomic ops): new shared acquire 1.01 ms/call, release 13.1 ms/call, vs the old exclusive lock(int,hashtext) at 4.17 ms/call in window and 35.4 ms/call cumulative. A bg-host restart at ~21:00Z inside the window undercounts bg-host call RATES for (a)/(e); per-call costs are unaffected. Full fleet-wide DB-time drop lands when :3070 deploys the same code.
